decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree that LH-01 and LH-02 are down. Likely repair is 13:30 and 14:30, so both Central stopes stay unloaded for hours. Central trucks have headroom (91 t/h against 36 t/h inflow). The only loaders that can be lent are the two development ones, since producing stopes are not touched and LH-10 is in PM until 12:00. LH-09 (cost 1.5 oz/h, 0.34 h away) goes to C564-14: 134 t at 12.1 g/t is about 52 oz, loaded in about 4.6 h. LH-08 (cost 1.0 oz/h, 0.75 h away) goes to C512-06: about 187 t at 9.2 g/t is about 55 oz by 17:00. The development cost is about 7 oz for each loader. Net is about 90 oz. Este is truck-limited, so no Este loader is moved. No reserves are activated because no stope was stopped.
